name: @w6w-apps/parseur
description: Turn incoming emails and documents into structured data with Parseur's AI mailboxes, and manage the templates, webhooks and custom downloads that shape what comes out.

w6w.longDescription:
Parseur turns unstructured emails, PDFs, images and spreadsheets into structured JSON. A mailbox (called a "parser" throughout the API) receives documents — forwarded emails, direct file uploads, or raw email/text posted straight to the API — and an AI or template engine extracts the fields you configure into a document record.

This app covers the full lifecycle: create and configure mailboxes, list and inspect the documents they've received (including per-document processing logs), submit new documents either as a binary upload or as an email/text payload, and drive documents through their own lifecycle (reprocess, skip, copy to another mailbox). It also manages the templates a mailbox uses to identify layouts, the webhooks that push parsed data out the moment a document finishes, and the custom CSV/XLS downloads Parseur can generate per mailbox or per field.

Authentication is a single account-wide API key, and Parseur's own health signal is the same call used to prove that key is live: hitting the API root returns a tiny routing map with no way to leak anything, so this app also uses it as its liveness probe rather than any endpoint that touches real mailbox data.
